meta.title: Release roadmap
meta.lede: What is shipping, what is next, and what we are working toward. Organised by release train, with a target quarter for each. Quarters are planning targets and can move.

trains.head: Speech, queue behaviour and agent experience
trains.note: The 12.2 train is generally available and has been extended through three maintenance builds. Items marked with a build number reached customers in that build rather than at the initial release.

maint.title: Maintenance builds in the 12.2 train
maint.note: Maintenance builds carry the capabilities tagged above alongside quality and stability fixes. Builds roll out per region on a staged schedule.

items.name: Bring your own Azure speech-to-text
items.desc: Use your own Azure Speech resource for transcription, with your own keys, region and billing.

items.name: Jabra device selection in the Worker app
items.desc: Select and control Jabra headsets from within the Worker app.

items.name: Configurable default landing page
items.desc: Choose which page agents see when they sign in to the agent apps.

items.name: Automatic focus on the live call page
items.desc: The live call view comes forward as soon as an agent answers, without a manual click.

items.name: Time range filter in call history
items.desc: Filter recent and missed calls by a chosen time range.

items.name: Recording retention policies
items.desc: Define how long recordings are kept and when they are removed automatically.

items.name: Anytime Queue Menu Access
items.desc: Callers can reach the in-queue menu at any time rather than only at cycle boundaries.

items.name: Automatic detection of not-ready agents
items.desc: Queue overflow that identifies agents left in a not-ready state

items.name: FlexApp presence status change
items.desc: Agents set their own availability status directly from the Flex app.

items.name: In-queue cycle time in seconds
items.desc: Configure the in-queue announcement cycle at second-level .

items.name: Agent custom view
items.desc: allowing opt-in/out and queue states view per Agent in worker group setting

items.name: Text-to-speech in Journey Manager
items.desc: present TTS prompts in Journey manager report

trains.head: Interim maintenance train
trains.note: A short train between 12.2 and 12.3 carrying targeted queue behaviour changes. Target date 11 October 2026.

items.name: Immediate start for in-queue announcement cycles
items.desc: Begin the in-queue announcement cycle at the start of the wait rather than after the first cycle interval elapses.

trains.head: Omnichannel, workforce management and the new Teams experience
trains.note: The largest train of the cycle. It adds WhatsApp as a channel, workforce management integration, post-call surveys, scheduled-report controls and a rebuilt Teams app experience.

items.name: New Teams app experience for Worker and Supervisor
items.desc: Rebuilt agent and supervisor apps inside Microsoft Teams, with a refreshed layout and faster navigation.

items.name: In-queue overflow routing
items.desc: Move waiting callers to an alternate queue or destination when thresholds are exceeded.

items.name: Callback outside business hours
items.desc: Offer a callback when the contact centre is closed, queued for the next open period.

items.name: Barge-in during text-to-speech prompts
items.desc: Callers can speak or press a key over a synthesised prompt instead of waiting for it to finish.

items.name: Post-call survey
items.desc: Collect caller feedback at the end of an interaction and report on the results alongside call data.

items.name: AI processing without recording retention
items.desc: Run transcription, summaries and insights on a call without retaining the audio, for environments with strict retention rules.

items.name: Queue performance metrics
items.desc: Average speed of answer and agent hunt time reported per queue.

items.name: Custom daily time window for scheduled reports
items.desc: Set the daily start and end time a scheduled report covers, instead of a fixed calendar day.

items.name: Clone a report schedule
items.desc: Duplicate an existing scheduled report and adjust it, rather than rebuilding from scratch.

items.name: omnichannel - WhatsApp
items.desc: Handle WhatsApp conversations in the same queues and agent workspace as voice.

items.name: BYO Workforce management
items.desc: Export interaction and adherence data to workforce management platforms for forecasting and scheduling.

items.name: Agent insights - Prebuilt CRM connectors for wrap up events
items.desc: More control over what call and wrap-up data is written back to the CRM record, and when.

items.name: Agent Phonebook search enhancements
items.desc: Search the organisation directory from the agent app before transferring or dialling.

items.name: Caller name in missed and recent calls tab
items.desc: Resolved contact names appear in call history rather than numbers alone.

items.name: Wrap-up events on outbound calls
items.desc: Apply the same Wrap-up events to outbound calls that are already available on inbound.

items.name: Flex Queue members recording
items.desc: allowing Teams clients and PSTN/3rd party ext. recording capabilities

items.name: Voca AIR setup wizard
items.desc: Guided setup for the AI receptionist, taking a new tenant from empty to answering calls.

trains.head: Outbound parity and supervisor reach
trains.note: Closes the gaps between inbound and outbound handling, extends supervisor monitoring to Operator Connect, and deepens the reporting set.

items.name: Immediate data export on configuration save
items.desc: Trigger the initial data export as soon as an export configuration is saved, without waiting for the next scheduled run.

items.name: Global variables in flows and queues
items.desc: Define a value once and reference it across call flows and queues instead of repeating it.

items.name: Live monitoring for outbound calls
items.desc: Supervisors can monitor outbound interactions, not only inbound.

items.name: SLA metrics in Voca Reports
items.desc: Service level attainment reported per queue and per period, against configurable targets.

items.name: Agent hunt timer in Voca Reports
items.desc: Reporting on how long calls ring at each agent before moving on.

items.name: Outbound conference in the Worker app
items.desc: Add a third party to an outbound call from the Worker app.

items.name: Live monitoring on Operator Connect
items.desc: Extends supervisor monitoring to tenants running Operator Connect.

items.name: Worker profiles, second phase
items.desc: Extends profiles with additional attributes and broader use across routing and reporting.

trains.head: Openness, custom reporting and the new routing engine
trains.note: Opens the platform up: public provisioning APIs, dashboards you build yourself, and a move to the AudioCodes routing engine.

items.name: Licensing model enhancements
items.desc: Second phase of the updated licensing model, including how usage is measured and reported.

items.name: Custom dashboards
items.desc: Assemble your own dashboard from available metrics rather than using fixed views.

items.name: Common and provisioning APIs
items.desc: Public APIs for provisioning and configuration, so tenant setup can be automated.

items.name: Conversational AI enhancements
items.desc: Improvements to intent handling, containment and tuning in the conversational layer.

items.name: AudioCodes Job Router
items.desc: Voca moves to an AudioCodes routing engine, giving more control over routing logic and behaviour.

trains.head: Assistive AI at the point of the call
trains.note: Moves AI from post-call analysis into the live interaction, and brings existing chatbots into the voice queue. From here the roadmap describes direction rather than committed scope.

items.name: Real-time agent assist
items.desc: Suggested answers and next steps surfaced to the agent while the call is still in progress.

items.name: Third-party chatbot integration with escalation to voice
items.desc: Hand a conversation from an existing chatbot to a Voca voice queue, carrying context across.

trains.head: Agentic tooling and platform consolidation
trains.note: Longer-horizon work. Listed to show intent, not to set expectations on timing.

items.name: Model Context Protocol support
items.desc: Expose Voca capabilities to AI agents and assistants through MCP.

evaluation.t: Agent overview on the home page
evaluation.d: A live team availability summary on the landing page of the agent apps.
Visibility of which colleague a call was transferred to, and its outcome.
Import additional contact attributes beyond the current field set.

evaluation.t: Caller name on the incoming call popup
evaluation.d: Under assessment. Depends on directory lookup behaviour in the underlying platform.
Under assessment. Depends on platform authentication capabilities outside Voca.

evaluation.d: There is automation and reports behind it on their end with report scheduler and they need UID to be added on the dtmf reporting.
